messages.subject: Series C - engaging Whitfield Carter
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We've agreed heads of terms in principle with Thornaby Growth Equity to lead our Series C - roughly £55m at a £210m pre. We'd like WC to act for the company. Can you send an engagement letter and let me know the team?

Marcus

messages.subject: RE: Series C - engaging Whitfield Carter
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Delighted - congratulations on getting this away. Engagement letter attached. I'll lead, with James Osei (senior associate) and Elena Marchetti day-to-day. Fee estimate £230k-£285k plus VAT; note the company will also cover Thornaby's counsel capped at £90k.

We'll turn the term sheet comments around this week.

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
